Asset type: LocalVoice home banner series. Exactly 1774x887 pixels, opaque full-bleed horizontal 2:1 image, one scene only.
Input images: Both supplied images are style and brand references, NOT a template of their Mediterranean location. Keep their human pencil drawing plus light transparent watercolor aesthetic, clean ivory paper, varied line pressure and incomplete soft edges. Replace the location with the specified famous place; retain the recognizable LocalVoice travel motifs and visual family.
Shared palette: deep teal green #075747 for delicate pencil contours and dark green earphones, sage #739C85 and pale mint for greenery and map regions, near-white warm ivory #FBFAF5 for paper, small muted pale blue water or sky and quiet cream/sand accents. Natural local stone colors are permitted as subtle washes. Avoid sepia-dominant tint, neon saturation, glossy rendering, thick cartoon outlines, uniform computer-smooth fills, excessive ornamental foliage, fake text or synthetic vignette.
Shared composition: eye-level or locally appropriate viewpoint, landmark recognizably prominent in the middle/background. Small folded three-panel map with cream road lines and sage/mint blocks, plus two simple dark green wired earphones, resting naturally on a low foreground ledge. Keep these items small enough that they do not obscure the landmark (about the lower quarter of the scene); all complete subjects comfortably inside the frame. No people, no logo, words, labels, numerals, border, watermark or UI. Ordinary daylight and relaxed asymmetry, readable at 350x175px. Authentic pencil observations with selective pale washes, not an over-rendered fantasy postcard. Do not add a Mediterranean house, ocean, hill or cypress when inappropriate for the chosen place.
Scene: Machu Picchu, recognizable Inca dry-stone ruins and stepped green terraces with steep Huayna Picchu peak directly behind, viewed from the classic elevated viewpoint. Small map and earphones on a low foreground stone ledge; no Mediterranean houses or European towers.
